title: Baking order
summary: Order {n_bakes:.0f} bakes in one oven to minimize their total tardiness.
text: One oven takes {n_bakes:.0f} bakes, one after another. Each bake has a duration and a due time; a bake that ends after its due time is late by the difference. Choose the order that minimizes the total lateness.

minutes.description: Duration of each bake, by its index

due.description: Due time of each bake, by its index, from the oven's start

variables.name: bake_order
variables.description: The order the bakes go into the oven
variables.meaning: Each entry is the index of a bake in minutes and due

objective.name: total_tardiness
objective.definition: The sum over bakes of max(0, end time - due time)

evaluator.notes: Run the bakes in the given order from time 0; sum each bake's lateness past its due time.
